title: Polynomial state complementation of two-way NFAs
exact_target: Is there a polynomial p independent of the finite alphabet such that every n-state two-way nondeterministic finite automaton has an equivalent complement-recognizing two-way NFA with at most p(n) states?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
